question: For each concert, show its name and the number of different singer countries represented among its performers, including concerts with none.
reference_sql: SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.Country) FROM concert AS c LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID LEFT JOIN singer AS s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
candidate_sql:
SELECT
    c.concert_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.Country) AS country_count
FROM concert AS c
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc
    ON sc.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer AS s
    ON sc.Singer_ID = CAST(s.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;
evaluation_evidence: Candidate results differ from the reference results.
